Meta.homeTitle: Sofra — Join a Turkish household table
Meta.homeDescription: Reserve a seat at a scheduled dinner inside a verified Turkish household, with a host-selected menu, tea, and genuine conversation.
Meta.tablesTitle: Household dinner tables in Istanbul · Sofra
Meta.tablesDescription: Explore approved household dinner tables in Istanbul by date, format, and approximate neighborhood.
Meta.howDescription: Learn how Sofra verifies households, protects private information, and supports a host-selected dinner from booking through tea and conversation.
Meta.hostTitle: Host a household table with Sofra
Meta.hostDescription: Learn how verified households propose their own menus and scheduled dinner tables for human review by Sofra.

Home.eyebrow: A place at a real table in Istanbul
Home.title: Come for dinner. Leave knowing the household.
Home.intro: Reserve a seat at a scheduled dinner inside a verified Turkish home. The household chooses the menu, sits with you, and makes time for tea and conversation.
Home.trustOneText: Every household and traveler capacity is reviewed by Sofra before publication.
Home.trustTwoText: The household shares the dinner it has chosen. Dietary needs are checked privately for compatibility.
Home.trustThreeText: A verified host joins the dinner or the tea-and-conversation period—always.
Home.nextIntro: Specific homes, specific evenings, and a clear sense of who will be at the table.
Home.storyEyebrow: This is how dinner happens in our home.
Home.storyTitle: Not a performance. Not a restaurant. A household welcoming you in.
Home.storyBody: Each home has its own rhythm, stories, and idea of a generous table. Sofra protects that difference while setting clear standards for safety, privacy, and hosting.
Home.rhythmTitle: The evening has room to breathe
rhythm: A household dessert or fruit tradition

How.eyebrow: A managed marketplace, from invitation to goodbye
How.title: What it means to join a Sofra table
How.intro: The household creates the evening. Sofra verifies the home, approves the scheduled table, protects private information, and supports both sides.

steps.title: Choose a scheduled table
steps.body: Browse a particular household, date, complete menu, table format, capacity, languages, and atmosphere.

steps.title: Share needs privately
steps.body: Tell Sofra about allergies, restrictions, or preferences. The question is whether the existing menu is compatible—not how to customize it.

steps.title: Reserve the whole experience
steps.body: See one all-inclusive price before checkout. Shared tables sell seats; private tables are kept for your party.

steps.title: Receive arrival details safely
steps.body: Public pages show only an approximate neighborhood. Exact arrival information appears only at the appropriate confirmed stage.

steps.title: Join dinner and stay for tea
steps.body: A verified host participates meaningfully, with space after dinner for Turkish tea or coffee and real conversation.

standards: Separate public reviews, private feedback, and safety reports
No guest selection by appearance or sensitive traits

Discovery.title: Find the evening that feels right
Discovery.intro: Every listing is a particular dinner—not a generic host profile. Explore the menu, household, format, timing, and atmosphere before you choose.
Discovery.emptyBody: Try both formats or a wider date window.

Table.menuNote: The household chooses the complete menu. Private disclosures help determine compatibility; they do not create a custom order.
Table.participants: Who from the household will join
Table.whereNote: The pin represents the approximate neighborhood. The exact home address is never public.
Table.noneJoining: No other parties have booked yet.
Table.priceIncludes: One all-inclusive price. No service fee appears later.
Table.minimumNote: This shared table needs at least {count} travelers before it is confirmed.
Table.exactAddress: Exact arrival details are shared only at the appropriate confirmed-booking stage.

HostRecruit.title: Share the dinner that already belongs to your home.
HostRecruit.intro: You choose the menu, the story, the dates, and the desired net payout. Sofra verifies the household, certifies capacity, approves every table, and supports safe hosting.
HostRecruit.participationBody: At least one verified adult host sits with travelers for dinner or the tea-and-conversation period. Hosting is not only cooking and serving.

Auth.title: Sign in to Sofra
Auth.intro: We’ll send a secure magic link to your email. No password is required.
Auth.demoNote: Remote authentication is not connected in demo mode. Use the demo personas to explore protected foundations.
Auth.verifyBody: Open the link we sent to finish signing in. You can close this page after the link opens.

Account.title: Your Sofra account
Account.description: Manage upcoming dinners and private traveler information.
Account.profileIntro: Public profile fields are kept separate from private dietary disclosures.
Account.profilePreview: Profile editing is not connected in this local preview. These read-only fields do not save or change durable account data.
Account.emptyUpcomingBody: When you reserve a household table, its preparation and confirmation progress will appear here.
Account.emptyBookingsBody: Browse approved household tables to begin your first Sofra reservation.

HostPortal.title: Host portal
HostPortal.description: Propose household tables, follow approval, and prepare for confirmed travelers.
HostPortal.seatsAvailable: {count, plural, one {# seat available} other {# seats available}}
HostPortal.certificationUnavailableBody: This household cannot propose another table until Sofra records an active certification and capacity.
HostPortal.submissionReviewed: The local demo validated this table’s move to Sofra review. No durable status changed, and the table remains private.
HostPortal.submissionUnavailable: No status changed. Production submission remains disabled until the protected table-write repository is connected.
HostPortal.newTableIntro: The household chooses the complete menu. Saving creates a private draft; publication always requires Sofra approval.
HostPortal.householdIntro: Public story and atmosphere. The private address lives in a separate protected record.
HostPortal.householdPreview: This is a fictional profile preview. Protected household writes are not connected, so these read-only fields cannot change durable data.
HostPortal.demoHouseholdStructure: A couple who have shared this neighborhood for three decades
HostPortal.demoHouseholdStory: Sunday dinner stretches into tea in this home. This is how dinner happens in our home.
HostPortal.privateRecordBody: This record is separate from the public neighborhood. It must never enter listing HTML, public map inputs, analytics, metadata, or public database views. Protected address writes are not connected, so these read-only fields do not save or echo an exact address.
HostPortal.readOnlyTable: This table is read-only while Sofra reviews or publishes it. Lifecycle changes go through the table service.
HostPortal.emptyTablesBody: Create a private draft when your household is ready to propose its first scheduled dinner.
HostPortal.emptyUpcomingTablesBody: Create a private draft when your household is ready to propose another dinner.

HostJourney.title: From private draft to hosted dinner

summaries.draft: This private draft can be revised and submitted; it is not visible to travelers.
summaries.submitted: Sofra review is required before this table can be approved or published.
summaries.changes_requested: Sofra requested changes. Revise the household’s proposal before resubmitting.
summaries.approved: The table is approved, but publication remains a separate Sofra-controlled step.
summaries.published: Travelers can request available seats while the table works toward its minimum.
summaries.minimum_reached: The minimum has been reached. Confirmed parties appear only in the delivery-safe roster.
summaries.confirmed: The dinner is confirmed. Prepare the approved menu, welcome, and host participation.
summaries.roster_locked: The delivery roster is locked for final preparation.
summaries.completed: The dinner is complete; feedback and payout controls remain separate records.
summaries.cancelled: This table’s normal journey has stopped. Cancellation handling remains an operations decision.
summaries.archived: This completed or cancelled table is retained as an archived record.

Admin.title: Sofra operations
Admin.description: Human-reviewed certification, publication, safety, and financial operations.
Admin.emptyApplicationsBody: New submitted applications will appear here for human review.
Admin.emptyTablesTitle: The table review queue is clear
Admin.emptyTablesBody: New submitted household tables will appear here before publication.
Admin.emptyAttentionBody: New host, table, and safety items will appear here when human attention is required.
Admin.tableReady: Complete menu and capacity ready for approval
Admin.bookingsIntro: Operational status without dietary text or additional-guest names.
Admin.pricingIntro: Development policy preview. A connected editor must create a new dated policy and audit entry instead of rewriting booking snapshots.
Admin.pricingPreviewBody: Policy writes are not connected in this environment. These values are typed launch defaults and cannot be changed from this screen.
Admin.restrictedApplication: Restricted application · exact home details are not part of this read model
Admin.assessmentPlaceholder: No assessment note is loaded in this preview
Admin.assessmentUnavailableBody: This read-only preview does not save private notes, certify a household, or change application status.
Admin.tableApprovedNotice: Table approved through the server service and recorded in the demo audit log. Publication remains a separate operator transition.
Admin.changesRequestedNotice: Changes requested and audit entry created. The host can revise before resubmitting.
Admin.privateAddressNotice: Private address reference is intentionally not rendered in the approval interface. Address verification is a separate privileged workflow.
Admin.actionAuditNote: Every action uses server-side permission checks and creates an audit entry.
Admin.confidentialDemoBody: This content is rendered only after server authorization. It is absent from public fixtures, analytics, and host or traveler pages.

Partner.title: Partner overview
Partner.description: A privacy-safe view of your organization’s referrals and public Sofra inventory.
Partner.upcomingBody: Only approved, public-safe listing fields are shown here.
Partner.scopeTitle: See referral progress without traveler identities
Partner.scopeBody: This workspace reports referral landings, attributed bookings, and completed dinners. Partner economics, the final attribution window, and settlement remain open decisions and are not calculated here.
Partner.organizationBody: Activity is limited to referrals owned by this partner organization.
Partner.activityBody: A conversion-stage view only. Traveler names, profiles, private metadata, payments, and commission amounts are excluded.
Partner.emptyActivity: No referral activity has been recorded for this organization yet.
Partner.emptyOrganizationBody: Sofra operations must assign this account to a partner organization before referral data can appear.
Partner.emptyUpcomingBody: Public-safe table inventory will appear here after Sofra approves and publishes it.

Booking.title: Request {menuTitle}
Booking.reservationIntro: Review your party, private compatibility information, and one all-inclusive price. No card fields are used in this Phase 1 flow.
Booking.additionalGuestsPlaceholder: One private name per additional traveler
Booking.dietaryNeedQuestion: Does anyone in your party need menu compatibility review?
Booking.dietaryHelp: Used only to assess this household’s existing menu. Never shared publicly or sent to analytics.
Booking.menuFixedTitle: The household’s menu stays as listed
Booking.menuFixedBody: Dietary information checks compatibility; it does not request a custom meal. Alcohol is not included or promised as part of this experience.
Booking.compatibility: I understand Sofra and the household must confirm menu compatibility.
Booking.policy: I understand the household chooses the menu, the exact address is private, and a shared table may need a minimum number of travelers.
Booking.disabledBody: Your reservation details can be reviewed, but Sofra cannot accept payment in this environment. No booking has been marked paid and no card details were requested.
Booking.mockBody: Local simulation is enabled. No card information will be collected.

errors.authenticationRequired: Sign in with a verified traveler account before requesting a table.
errors.tableUnavailable: The requested seats are no longer available.
errors.partyTooLarge: This party exceeds the current shared-table booking limit.
errors.bookingClosed: The booking cutoff for this table has passed.
errors.invalidRequest: Review the party and acknowledgment fields before continuing.
errors.simulatedFailure: The local payment simulation did not authorize this request.

Booking.reviewBody: These details are ready, but they are not a paid or durable booking in this environment.

TravelerBooking.disclosureSeparated: Disclosure content remains in the private dietary record and does not appear here.
TravelerBooking.approximateVisible: The approximate neighborhood is visible now.
TravelerBooking.arrivalSeparate: Arrival instructions remain separate until the appropriate confirmed stage.
TravelerBooking.otherTravelersPrivate: Other travelers never see your name or dietary needs.
TravelerBooking.cancellationReviewedBody: The local demo validated that this booking can move to cancelled, but it did not change durable data or decide a refund. The final cancellation and refund policy remains an open product decision.
TravelerBooking.cancellationUnavailableBody: No cancellation was recorded. Production cancellation remains disabled until durable booking writes and the final refund policy are approved.

BookingJourney.title: Where this reservation stands
BookingJourney.intro: Compatibility, payment, the table minimum, and dinner completion remain separate states.

messages.reservationRecorded: Party and price details were recorded for this booking.
messages.compatibilityAccepted: The household’s existing menu was accepted for the disclosed needs.
messages.compatibilityNotRequired: No private compatibility review was required.
messages.compatibilityPending: Private dietary information is awaiting compatibility review.
messages.compatibilityDeclined: The existing menu was not accepted as compatible; this booking cannot be confirmed.
messages.paymentAuthorized: Payment is authorized for the recorded all-inclusive total.
messages.paymentCreated: A payment attempt exists but is not yet authorized.
messages.paymentHeld: The payment is held for operational review.
messages.tableAwaitingPrerequisites: Table confirmation waits for payment and any required compatibility review.
messages.tablePendingMinimum: This shared table is waiting for its required traveler minimum.
messages.tableConfirmed: The table is confirmed for the recorded party.
messages.tableCompleted: The table was confirmed and the dinner is complete.
messages.tableCancelled: The booking is no longer active. Refund handling is tracked separately.
messages.tableDisputed: This booking is under operational review.
messages.dinnerCompleted: The dinner is complete; review and private feedback are available.
messages.dinnerUpcoming: Dinner details will remain here as the booking progresses.
messages.dinnerStopped: The normal dinner journey is paused or ended for this booking.

Dietary.intro: Disclosures are attached to a traveler or booking for compatibility review, never to a public profile.
Dietary.privacyBody: This is kept outside your public profile and excluded from product analytics. Hosts receive only the information needed to assess and deliver a confirmed dinner.
Dietary.explanation: What should the compatibility reviewer understand?
Dietary.saved: Validated in the local demo. No durable disclosure was stored, and no analytics payload contains it.

Demo.title: Choose a local demo persona
Demo.intro: These personas are available only in local development. They set an HTTP-only demo session and never grant production access.
Demo.guidedBody: Move through qualification, publication, booking, hosting, feedback, and intervention with the correct role and privacy boundary at every step.

DemoJourney.title: From household application to careful follow-up
DemoJourney.intro: Each card opens the real Phase 1 surface with the correct fictional persona. The journey is read-only: actions validate rules and demonstrate outcomes without claiming durable state.
DemoJourney.readOnly: Read-only fictional journey · no remote services

qualify.title: Qualify the household
qualify.body: A human-reviewed application establishes who may host and the certified traveler capacity.

publish.title: Create and approve a scheduled table
publish.body: The household shapes the evening; Sofra independently reviews it before anything becomes public.

welcome.title: Reserve and prepare
welcome.body: Travelers understand the complete menu and price while hosts receive only the operational context they need.

followUp.title: Learn, intervene, and settle
followUp.body: Public praise, private improvement notes, safety reports, payout controls, and audit records stay deliberately separate.

application.title: Review the application
application.body: Operators see the household proposal and keep assessment notes inside a restricted workflow.

certification.title: See the certified household
certification.body: The host workspace reflects approved capacity and participating household members.

draft.title: Shape a household table
draft.body: The host owns the menu, story, date, atmosphere, participation, and desired net payout.

moderation.title: Approve before publication
moderation.body: An operator checks capacity, menu completeness, participation, and practical information.

discovery.title: Publish a safe listing
discovery.body: Travelers see the approximate neighborhood and experience details, never a home address.

booking.title: Track a pending reservation
booking.body: A booking can wait for the shared-table minimum while payment and compatibility remain explicit states.

roster.title: Prepare the host roster
roster.body: Hosts see party counts and compatibility decisions without a public guest-selection surface.

confirmed.title: Confirm the traveler
confirmed.body: The account explains status, timing, privacy, and what happens before arrival.

feedback.title: Separate feedback channels
feedback.body: The traveler’s public review and private constructive note are presented as different records.

incident.title: Restrict safety handling
incident.body: Only authorized operators can inspect a confidential report and its operational effect.

payout.title: Hold payout safely
payout.body: An open safety review prevents release without exposing the underlying report elsewhere.

audit.title: Preserve accountability
audit.body: Material lifecycle and financial actions leave a reasoned operator-visible record.

Roster.privacyBody: This roster shows party size and compatibility decisions. Dietary disclosure text, appearance, and sensitive traveler traits are intentionally absent.
Roster.empty: No confirmed party information is available for this table yet.

checklist.menu: Prepare the complete household-selected menu as approved.
checklist.participation: Confirm that a verified adult host joins dinner or tea and conversation.
checklist.welcome: Keep the welcome clear and give every party the same practical orientation.
checklist.tea: Leave unhurried time for dessert or fruit, Turkish tea or coffee, and conversation.

Feedback.separationBody: Public experience reviews help future travelers. Constructive notes stay private to Sofra operations and are never appended to the public review.
Feedback.publicIntro: Share what the household experience felt like. Sofra reviews this channel before anything becomes public.
Feedback.privateIntro: Send a practical improvement note to Sofra operations without adding it to the household’s public review.
Feedback.publicPrivacyAcknowledgment: I have excluded exact address details, dietary information, private guest information, and safety concerns from this public review.
Feedback.publicNote: Public review content stays pending until moderation; it must not identify other travelers or reveal private home details.
Feedback.privateNote: This channel remains separate from public reviews and analytics. The local demo never echoes its content after submission.
Feedback.safetyTitle: Safety reports take a different path
Feedback.safetyBody: A safety concern is not a review or private improvement note. It enters a restricted incident workflow and requires any linked payout to be held while the concern is open.
Feedback.notEmergencyTitle: This local demo is not monitored
Feedback.notEmergencyBody: Do not rely on this form for immediate help. Contact the appropriate local emergency service if anyone is in immediate danger.

public_reviewed.title: Public review boundary validated
public_reviewed.body: The local demo validated a moderation-pending review. Nothing was stored or published, and the review text was not echoed or logged.

private_reviewed.title: Private feedback boundary validated
private_reviewed.body: The local demo validated an operations-only note. Nothing was stored, and the private text was not echoed, logged, or sent to analytics.

safety_reviewed.title: Restricted safety path validated
safety_reviewed.body: The local demo validated an open incident and required payout hold. No incident or payout changed, and the confidential report was not echoed, logged, or sent to analytics.

unavailable.title: Post-dinner submission is not connected
unavailable.body: Nothing was recorded. Production submission remains disabled until the protected write repository and transactional payout hold are connected.

Payouts.title: Payout controls
Payouts.intro: Operator-visible settlement states. No provider release is attempted in this environment.
Payouts.holdBody: A payout cannot be released while a related safety incident remains open. The confidential report stays in the incident workflow.

States.unauthorizedTitle: This area needs a different account role
States.unauthorizedBody: Choose an appropriate demo persona locally, or sign in with an authorized Sofra account when Supabase is connected.
States.notFoundTitle: That table is no longer available
States.notFoundBody: It may have filled, passed its booking cutoff, or returned to review.
States.errorTitle: We couldn’t set the table just now
States.errorBody: Nothing was charged. Please return to the available tables and try again.
